Definition: from a derivative of G1950; negligence:--X forgetful.
BiblicalUsage: Epilesmone is forgetfulness — and James contrasts the forgetful hearer with the man who looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues therein, not being a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work.
TheologicalSignificance: Forgetfulness is the quiet enemy of faith, I believe: the word heard and forgotten is the word never obeyed.
